create_TrainLogs: create a TrainLogs instance to extract training logs matching a regex pattern
build_train_logs_dataframe: build a pandas DataFrame of training logs by instantiating TrainLogs and accessing the train_logs property
build_test_logs_dataframe: build a pandas DataFrame of test logs by instantiating TrainLogs and accessing the test_logs property
build_configs_dataframe: build a pandas DataFrame of hyper-parameters and model configurations from training run configs
build_combined_logs: build a combined pandas DataFrame of train and test logs merged with config data via the logs property
